GOOD TO KNOW

A few quick answers.

How does takeaway ordering work?

Add dishes to your bag, choose a pickup time and enter your details. This demo generates a sample confirmation only. For real orders, call the restaurant.

Can I book outdoor catering?

Yes. Hotel Sabah's card lists outdoor catering. Use the demo enquiry form to see the booking flow; call to confirm the event, quote and availability.

Are these the final menu prices?

No. All menu prices and most dishes are illustrative. Mutton biryani, chicken tandoori and paya soup are specialities listed on the supplied card.

Can I request changes or mention allergies?

Add a note at checkout and speak to the restaurant about ingredients and preparation before a real order. Dietary requests need confirmation.

Can I pay online?

This demo does not accept payments. Payment options must be agreed with the restaurant for live orders.
